questions.question_text: Te Akṣharnā be swarūp chhe - ek to nirākār ekras chaitanya chhe tene Chidākāsh kahīe, Brahmamahol kahīe; ane e Akṣhar bīje rūpe karīne ______ sevāmā rahe chhe.
questions.explanation: Vachanamrut Ga. Pr. 21 states that Akshar in its second form resides in the service of Purushottam Narayan.

questions.question_text: Akṣharnā be swarūpmāthī, ek to nirākār ekras chaitanya chhe tene _________ kahīe.
questions.explanation: As per Vachanamrut Ga. Pr. 21, the nirakar ekras chaitanya form of Akshar is called Chidakash and Brahmamahol.

questions.question_text: Sampradāynī puṣhṭi māṭe, te shāstra Sanskṛut hoy athavā bhāṣhā hoy paṇ ________ sampradāynī puṣhṭi kare, paṇ te vinā bījo granth potānā sampradāynī puṣhṭi na kare.
questions.explanation: Vachanamrut Ga. Ma. 58 specifies that only 'te ja granth' (that specific scripture of the Ishtadev's charitra) fortifies the sampraday.

questions.question_text: Potānā iṣhṭadevnā je janmathī karīne deh mūkavā paryant charitra tenu je shāstra teṇe karīne _______ thāy chhe.
questions.explanation: According to Vachanamrut Ga. Ma. 58, the scripture detailing the Ishtadev's life from birth to leaving the body leads to the fortification of the sampraday.

questions.question_text: Kyā granth vagar potānā sampradāynī puṣhṭi na thāy?
options: Iṣhṭadevnā janmathī karīne deh mūkavā paryant charitra tenu je shāstra
questions.correct_answer: Iṣhṭadevnā janmathī karīne deh mūkavā paryant charitra tenu je shāstra
questions.explanation: Vachanamrut Ga. Ma. 58 explicitly states 'paṇ te vinā bījo granth potānā sampradāynī puṣhṭi na kare', referring to the shastra of the Ishtadev's charitra.

questions.question_text: Vachanāmṛut kartā bījāmā māl manāy chhe e _______ jāṇvo.
questions.explanation: Swamini Vato 4/132 identifies believing other things to be superior to Vachanamrut as 'moh'.

questions.question_text: Āvī vātu bīje kyāī nathī; ā to ______, ______, ane ______ chhe.
questions.explanation: Swamini Vato 4/34 describes these talks as being of Akshardham, Bhagwan, and Narayan.

questions.question_text: Ā vātu ______ chedī nākhe evī bhagwān puruṣhottamnī vātu chhe.
questions.explanation: Swamini Vato 5/176 states that these talks of Bhagwan Purushottam cut through infinite doubts.

questions.question_text: Ā vātomānthī to brahmarūp thavāshe bāḷ, joban ane vṛuddha e traṇ prakārnī strīo, _______ ane ______ e badhu sarkhu thaī jashe.
questions.explanation: Swamini Vato 1/33 mentions that through these talks, trash and gold will become equal.

questions.question_text: Ā vātomānthī brahmarūp thavāthe shu sarkhu thaī jashe?
options: bāḷ, joban ane vṛuddha e traṇ prakārnī strīo, kacharo ane kanchan
questions.correct_answer: bāḷ, joban ane vṛuddha e traṇ prakārnī strīo, kacharo ane kanchan
questions.explanation: Swamini Vato 1/33 lists these items as becoming equal through these talks, enabling one to become brahmarup.
